name: isRegistered
desc: Checks whether type T is registered in the container.

name: registerFactory
desc: Registers a factory function factory for type T which is executed on every resolve call.

name: registerLazySingleton
desc:
Registers a lazy singleton factory for type T.
The factory will be invoked only when resolve is called for the first time.

name: registerMock
desc:
Registers a mock or override instance for type T, bypassing normal duplicate check.
This is intended for unit testing or dynamic service swapping.

name: registerSingleton
desc: Registers a pre-instantiated singleton instance for type T.

name: reset
desc: Resets all registered factories and singletons in the container.

name: resolve
desc: Resolves the registered instance or factory for type T.
